bullets.text: For crypto/xor: use known-plaintext ('picoCTF{') to recover the XOR key. Typical tool path: shell -> submit.
For forensics/recover: search the artifact for printable flag text. Typical tool path: shell -> submit.
For reversing/constant: read the source and invert the per-byte transform. Typical tool path: read -> shell -> submit.
For crypto/encoding: identify the encoding and decode it. Typical tool path: read -> shell -> submit.
For crypto/classical: treat as a classical substitution; brute force the key/shift. Typical tool path: read -> shell -> submit.
